steps.name: Define Research Hypothesis
steps.description: Articulate a clear, testable hypothesis based on the clinical context, specifying the population, intervention, comparator, and expected outcome.

steps.name: Literature Review & Gap Analysis
steps.description: Conduct a systematic review of existing studies to confirm the novelty of the hypothesis and identify methodological strengths/weaknesses to inform study design.

steps.name: Develop Study Protocol
steps.description: Create a detailed protocol that outlines objectives, study design (e.g., RCT, cohort), inclusion/exclusion criteria, sample size calculations, randomization method, blinding, intervention details, outcome measures, and statistical analysis plan.

steps.name: Ethics & Regulatory Approval
steps.description: Prepare and submit the protocol, informed consent forms, and safety monitoring plans to an Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Ethics Committee and obtain any required regulatory approvals (e.g., FDA or EMA).

steps.name: Site Selection & Training
steps.description: Identify clinical sites capable of recruiting the target population, verify infrastructure, and conduct training sessions for investigators and study staff on protocol adherence, data capture, and safety reporting.

steps.name: Participant Recruitment & Screening
steps.description: Implement recruitment strategies (e.g., referrals, advertisements), screen candidates against inclusion/exclusion criteria, obtain written informed consent, and document baseline characteristics.

steps.name: Randomization & Intervention Delivery
steps.description: Assign participants to intervention or control groups using a pre‑specified randomization scheme, ensure blinding where applicable, and administer the intervention per the protocol while monitoring adherence.

steps.name: Data Collection & Monitoring
steps.description: Collect outcome data at predefined time points using validated instruments, enter data into a secure electronic data capture system, and perform regular data monitoring for completeness, consistency, and safety signals.

steps.name: Statistical Analysis & Interpretation
steps.description: Apply the pre‑specified statistical analysis plan to evaluate the primary and secondary outcomes, conduct sensitivity analyses, assess clinical relevance, and interpret findings in the context of the original hypothesis.

steps.name: Dissemination of Results
steps.description: Prepare manuscripts for peer‑reviewed journals, present findings at scientific conferences, update trial registries, and provide summaries to participants and stakeholders, ensuring transparent reporting according to CONSORT or relevant guidelines.
